content.title: Disc Golf Courses
content.summary: The City of Arvada offers two disc golf courses: Johnny Roberts Disc Golf Course and Bird's Nest Disc Golf Course. From late February through April 2026, holes 2 and 3 of the Johnny Roberts course will be closed for a stormwater improvement project aimed at repairing creek damage and preventing erosion, while the Bird's Nest course features 27 holes set in a scenic landscape.
content.body:
![Man throwing a disc at disc golf course ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=1222 "Man throwing a disc at disc golf course ")

The City of Arvada has two disc golf courses, Johnny Roberts Disc Golf Course and Bird's Nest Disc Golf Course.

## Johnny Roberts Disc Golf

**Holes 2 and 3 of the Johnny Robert Disc Golf Course will be temporarily closed starting in late February through April 2026** as part of a stormwater improvement project. The project will repair and stabilize damaged sections of the stone creek crossing between holes 2 and 3, as well as address erosion along the creek bank.

This work is necessary to protect the creek, improve safety, and ensure long-term access to the course. Visit the [stormwater system improvement page](/1416) for more information.

- Location: Memorial Park at [8001 West 59th Avenue](https://www.google.com/maps/place/8001+W+59th+Ave,+Arvada,+CO+80004/@39.8037908,-105.0861168,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m2!3m1!1s0x876b8629879f9911:0x227618c2f2458bb0) behind City Hall and Police Headquarters
- A short 18-hole course that is often very busy
- [Johnny Robert's Disc Golf Course Map](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=1221)

## Bird's Nest Disc Golf Course

- Located at [17925 West 64th Parkway](https://goo.gl/maps/2vx8b) just east of Highway 93 on 64th Avenue south of the Arvada-Blunn Reservoir
- A 27-hole course that features rolling pastures, tree-lined holes and some elevation change
- [Bird's Nest Disc Golf Course Map](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=1220)
